about.title: About Slow Darija
about.intro: We believe the best way to learn a language is slowly, naturally, and with real people.
about.mission_desc: To make Moroccan Darija accessible to everyone, regardless of their background or learning speed.
about.story_desc: Slow Darija was born from a simple observation: traditional language courses move too fast and feel too artificial. We wanted to create something different — a space where learning Darija feels like a natural conversation, not a classroom exercise.
about.approach_desc: We pair you with native Darija speakers for live, 1-on-1 lessons. No scripts, no rigid curriculum — just authentic conversations tailored to your level and interests.
